name: S7 — the pane folds to one line and comes back with the same words
why: The pane has two shapes: the window a live turn writes into, and the one-line 'Thinking…' the operator folds it to when they want the conversation out of the way. Folding must not be the end of the words — the operator asked for a pane that keeps what it has, and clicking it again has to bring the same text back, not an empty box and not a second copy of the box.
